The Brain & Performance Centre

The Individual Path

A brand film following one child's route through the clinic's assessment and treatment pathway — told through the voice of the clinic's medical director, from first consultation to a family's first steps forward at home.

Runtime
≈ 90 sec
Scenes
8
Shots
32
Style
3D animation
braindubai

Scene 01

Modern Clinic - Lobby

4 shots

A bright, airy space. ZAYNAB (40s, warm eyes, wearing a white coat) stands near a large window. In the background, children of various backgrounds play with adaptive toys.

A young boy, THAL (8), sits in a specialized stroller, focusing intently on a digital tablet.

ZAYNAB · line 1

“Every child with cerebral palsy has different strengths, different challenges—and different possibilities.”

Zaynab walks toward a hallway.

ZAYNAB · line 2

“That’s why your child’s journey with us begins with a comprehensive assessment over several days.”

Scene 02

Clinic - Assessment Room

4 shots

Thal is on a soft mat. A multidisciplinary team surrounds him: KWAME (30s, Occupational Therapist) and REI (30s, Physical Therapist). They move Thal’s limbs gently, observing his range of motion.

ZAYNAB · line 1

“Our consultant pediatrician, physical therapy, occupational therapy, neuropsychology and dietetics teams work together to understand your child holistically—not simply their diagnosis.”

Kwame holds up a colorful ball. Thal reaches for it. Kwame notes the movement on a clipboard.

ZAYNAB · line 2

“We look at movement, balance, upper-limb function, communication, cognition, nutrition, comfort and independence in everyday life.”
